actual_scope: Coverage audit of the stated asymptotic side conditions (exponent inequalities, o(p)/fits-the-record/eventually claims) of the pending T74 capped-fusion outer at PR #2044 head 322949a5: are all conditions written in the 28 inherited notes (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion, PR1758 gauge-free interiors and union schedule, PR1786 fine-prime padding, structured/Strassen boundary) encoded as ledger strict checks and true at the family's final parameter point (eps = 1-2e-30010, beta = 1-6e-30010)? Plus the open review items on the disabled `or True` guard and per-record g^2 charges.
scope_change_reason: The card asks to prove or falsify one implication. Maintainer reviews of #1673/#1758/#1876/#1928 leave the shared parameter-inequality interfaces and the `or True` / g^2-per-record items open, and the family's final point moved beta and eps to within 1e-30010 of 1, far from the point at which PR1673's notes were written. A complete exact inventory of the written side conditions at that point decides whether any stated condition silently fails there. It does not prove the arguments themselves.
bottleneck_link: Audit of the leading pending frontier candidate (claimed kappa 0.0016797549..., +0.43% over the selected record). A false load-bearing side condition would invalidate the stack; none was found in the written text, which narrows the remaining review to the non-exponent obligations listed in the inventory.
stop_rule: All 28 md notes of the #2044 outer/vendor tree extracted once by four independent extractors; every one of the 554 extracted conditions classified and exactly evaluated at four points; every flagged item double-checked (refute + re-derive); a seeded random sample of 28 non-flagged classifications independently re-translated.
evidence: verify.py: PASS_T74_SIDE_CONDITION_COVERAGE conditions=554 keys=133 covered=262 auto_true=53 obsolete=113 stale_text_only=64 non_exponent=58 false_at_point=3 uncovered_true=1 ambiguous=0 load_bearing_false=0 (default mode, 14 negative controls; --source-root mode re-hashes 32 #2044 files, locates all 554 quotes, equates rebuilt parameters and 49 ledger checks with LEDGER.json, 16 controls). Two independent verdicts per flagged item and a seeded 28-item sampled re-check (27 agree; the one disagreement corrected) are recorded in INVENTORY.json.
